about: Every gun in a match. All are Cyberpunk's own weapons, given by their TweakDB record; the Ray Gun is Cyberpunk's Militech Omaha wearing Black Ops' real Ray Gun model, which the launcher builds from the player's Black Ops on each Play.

columns.name: name shown in the buy prompts
columns.record: Cyberpunk TweakDB item record given to V
columns.role: start (V's only gun when a match starts) | wall (a wall-buy) | box (Mystery Box) | rare (Mystery Box, a third as likely)
columns.cost: wall-buy price in points (0 for start, box and rare)
columns.ammo: Cyberpunk ammo record given with the gun
columns.ammo_amount: rounds given with the gun (and for a repeat wall-buy at half price)
columns.tested_in_game: true once bought and fired in a match
